subject: evs
title: Torch: hidden life in a pond
topic: Shine the torch to find 6 hidden animals
instruction: Shine your torch on the drawing. Hold it still on something to find who lives in the pond.
intro: Six animals are hiding in this pond. Use your torch to find them all.

targets.label: Fish
targets.say: Fish breathe under water using gills.

targets.label: Tadpoles
targets.say: Tadpoles are baby frogs. They grow legs and turn into frogs.

targets.label: Snail
targets.say: A snail carries its shell like a house and moves on one slimy foot.

targets.label: Turtle
targets.say: A turtle can live in water and on land. Its hard shell keeps it safe.

targets.label: Dragonfly
targets.say: A dragonfly has four wings. Its babies grow up under the water.

targets.label: Kingfisher
targets.say: The kingfisher dives into the water to catch fish with its long beak.

doneText: You found everyone in the pond!
